A comment at memo_service.go:603 references DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook.

The dispatcher function is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `memo_service_webhooks.go`. The handler calls it from `memo_service.go` near line 157. HTTP delivery is handled by `internal/webhook` using Go's standard `net/http` package. There is no third-party signing library.

The signing mechanism is Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256. It uses headers `webhookid`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature: v1,<base64 hmac>`. A test named `TestPostSignsRequest` verifies this end-to-end signature.
